JOYSTAR New Berry Kids Bike - Sizes 12" to 20"
Inspire a love for the outdoors with the JOYSTAR New Berry Kids Bike. Combining a sleek, modern design with rugged durability, this bike is the perfect companion for boys and girls aged 3 to 13 as they master the art of riding.

Modern aesthetics meet rugged performance: The JOYSTAR New Berry in Classic White.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Built to withstand every tumble and triumph, the New Berry features a reinforced steel frame and a responsive braking system tailored for small hands."
Advanced Safety Systems
The JOYSTAR New Berry is constructed with a high-tensile HI-TEN steel frame, ensuring it can handle years of sidewalk adventures. It features a dual-braking system: a rear coaster brake for intuitive stopping and a front caliper hand brake to help older children transition to adult-style braking.

Precision braking and a sturdy build for total peace of mind.

Key Features & Benefits

Ergonomic Design: A low-standover frame makes it easy for kids to hop on and off independently.

Growth-Compatible: Quick-release seat post and adjustable handlebars allow the bike to grow as they do.

Full Chain Guard: Keeps little legs clean and prevents snags or contact with the drivetrain.

Smooth Rolling: 2.125" wide pneumatic tires provide excellent shock absorption and stability on various terrains.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Don't let complicated instructions slow you down. The JOYSTAR New Berry arrives 85% pre-assembled. We provide the tools and a straightforward guide to get your child riding in under 25 minutes.

Step-by-Step: Fast and easy assembly so the fun starts sooner.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

Customer Review & Unboxing
See why parents and kids love the JOYSTAR New Berry. Watch this real-world review and unboxing to see the bike's quality and features up close from a customer's perspective.

Real Stories: Check out what our community has to say about the New Berry experience.

Explore Every Detail
Get a close-up look at the craftsmanship and safety features of the JOYSTAR New Berry. This video highlights the reinforced frame, precision braking system, and the premium finish that sets our bikes apart.

Detailed Walkthrough: A closer look at the New Berry's engineering and design.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR is committed to quality. We offer a comprehensive warranty to ensure your child enjoys their ride for years to come:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Our steel frames are covered against defects for the life of the original owner.

2-Year Component Coverage: Non-wear parts are protected for 24 months.
